# sherpa-slider

A single-value range control wrapping a native &lt;input type=range>.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | control |
| Figma | Slider |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-slider/sherpa-slider.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-slider/sherpa-slider.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-slider/sherpa-slider.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-slider/sherpa-slider.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-slider/sherpa-slider.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-slider data-label="Volume" min="0" max="100" step="5" value="40" data-show-value></sherpa-slider>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-label` | text |  | label text above the slider (shown when set) |
| `data-show-value` | boolean | `false` | show the editable value field under the track ; a range's two fields share that row, half each |
| `data-type` | `single` `range` | `single` | single \| range — two thumbs and two value fields |
| `data-value-end` | text |  | the range ends (data-type="range" only) |
| `data-value-readonly` | boolean |  | make the value display read-only (no typing) |
| `data-value-start` | text |  | the range ends (data-type="range" only) |
| `disabled` | boolean, native | `false` | disabled state |
| `max` | text, native |  | maximum value (native, default 100) |
| `min` | text, native |  | minimum value (native, default 0) |
| `name` | text, native |  | the form field its value, or a range's two ends, are submitted under |
| `step` | text, native |  | step increment (native, default 1) |
| `value` | text, native |  | current value (native) |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Access | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `number` | read and write | the current value (read/write, clamped to min/max) |
| `range` | `[number, number]` | read and write | the two ends (read/write); low end first |

## Methods

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `checkValidity()` | Is it acceptable, as its form sees it? |
| `reportValidity()` | Check, and show the browser's message on the control. |
| `formDisabledCallback()` | Inside a disabled `<fieldset>`, as by its own `disabled`. |
| `formResetCallback()` | A form reset puts back its first values. |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| `input` | `{ end: number; start: number; value: number }` | While dragging / typing. |
| `change` | `{ end: number; start: number; value: number }` | On commit. |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`fill`, `label`, `range`, `range-end`, `track`, `value`, `value-start`
